====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding dance production means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Dance Production.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Dance Production. Get clear on dance production before moving on. How would you explain dance production to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Outline the roles of a dance director in dance production,. Clue from the topic: Digital literacy: The learner uses music device to create accompaniment to the dance. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Digital literacy: The learner uses music device to create accompaniment to the dance.
• Creativity and imagination: The learner creates accompanying rhythms that are relevant to the selected dance genre.
• Citizenship: The learner develops dances on pertinent and contemporary issues affecting the society like safety on roads.
• Unity: The learner works with others in dance performance.
• Respect: The learner critiques and recognises the input of others in the dance performance.
• Patriotism: The learner creates dance music to express the awareness of their own cultures.
